inputs.text: Mahama’s commitment to the rule of law has to mean protecting people with the least power, even when their rights are unpopular. “Collective agreement” is not automatically fair: culture and consensus can reflect inequality and reinforce exclusion. Human rights must constrain majority power, not depend on majority approval.

output.main_topic: Protecting human rights and people with the least power under the rule of law
